title: Synthetic Studio Backend
summary: A Python backend offering per-domain (education, healthcare, finance) data anonymization and class-balancing pipelines that combine Presidio, imblearn, and standalone CTGAN with SDV's tabular API. SDV's sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer and sdv.metadata.Metadata/SingleTableMetadata are imported and instantiated to synthesize tabular data alongside a separate direct ctgan.CTGAN usage.
evidence: models/finance_models.py: 'from sdv.single_table.ctgan import CTGANSynthesizer' and synthesis_models.py: 'synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata=metadata, epochs=...)'
needs: File is named 'synthesis_models[not used].py', suggesting the SDV call site may be dead code not wired into the running app; unclear if it executes in production.
